idea-plugin.name: LogParser Pro
idea-plugin.description:
LogParser Pro — Advanced Log Analysis in Your IDE

Stop switching between your IDE and log viewers. LogParser Pro brings professional log analysis directly into your JetBrains IDE with colour-coded levels, filtering, pattern matching, correlation tracking, and ML-powered anomaly detection.

Features

  • Colour-Coded Log Levels — ERROR, WARN, INFO, DEBUG, TRACE highlighted for instant visibility
  • Dedicated Log Editor — Custom editor tab for .log and .out files with table view
  • Log Level Filtering — Toggle buttons to filter by severity
  • Keyword Search — Live filtering across log entries
  • Pattern Library — Auto-detection of Spring Boot, Node.js, Python, and Java formats
  • Structured Logs — JSON and logfmt parser extracting timestamp / level / message / arbitrary fields
  • Gzip Support — Transparent reading of *.log.gz and other gzip-encoded logs
  • Stack Trace Folding — Collapse exception stack traces for readability
  • Exception Grouping — Group stack traces by normalised signature (line numbers, lambdas, hashes ignored)
  • Error Timeline — Minute-granularity histogram with z-score spike detection
  • Log Diff — Compare two logs by normalised message signature (digits/UUIDs/timestamps collapsed)
  • Secret Redaction — Mask emails, JWTs, Bearer tokens, AWS keys, Stripe keys, credit cards (Luhn-verified), IPs, UUIDs and password assignments before sharing a log
  • Grok Pattern Compiler — Elastic Grok subset compiled to native regex for custom extractors
  • Safe Export — CSV (RFC-4180 with formula-injection mitigation), JSON, and standalone HTML with HTML-escaped content
  • Correlation ID Tracking — Follow request flows across microservices
  • Advanced Search — Regex, fuzzy, and proximity search with log indexing
  • Anomaly Detection — Statistical pattern discovery and anomaly scoring
  • Log Indexing — Fast indexed search across large log files
  • Statistics Dashboard — Level distribution, top loggers, entries over time
  • Rich Settings — Configurable via Settings → Tools → LogParser Pro

Requirements

  • IntelliJ IDEA 2023.2+ (or any JetBrains IDE build 232+)
  • JDK 17+

Support

  • Issue Tracker
  • Documentation
idea-plugin.change-notes:
2026.8.0

  • The plugin is now completely free — all features unlocked, no license needed.
  • Source code is now open source under Apache-2.0: https://github.com/JirakJ/logparser-premium-plugin

2026.4.1 — Production Power Tools

  • Gzip support — Transparent reading of *.log.gz (by name or magic number) with no file-type hijack
  • Structured parser — JSON and logfmt detection with nested-field flattening and epoch / ISO timestamps
  • Exception grouping — Tools → LogParser Pro → Group Exceptions; normalises lambdas, hex addresses, line numbers
  • Error timeline — Minute-bucket histogram with z-score spike detection
  • Log diff — Compare two logs by normalised signature (digits, UUIDs, timestamps collapsed)
  • Secret redaction — Mask emails, JWTs, Bearer tokens, AWS/Stripe keys, Luhn-verified credit cards, IPs, UUIDs, password assignments
  • Grok pattern compiler — Elastic Grok subset → native Regex with cycle and expansion guards
  • Safer export — CSV mitigates spreadsheet formula injection; HTML export HTML-escapes all content
  • Live tail reader — Byte-accurate incremental reader with truncation detection
  • 100% unit-tested core (300+ tests)

2026.3.10 — Freemium Model

  • Freemium licensing — Added product-descriptor for JetBrains Marketplace freemium model (code: PLOGPARSERPRO)

2026.3.7 — Complete Rewrite

  • LanguageFileType — Proper LogLanguage + LanguageFileType + ParserDefinition integration
  • Syntax Highlighting — Colour-coded log levels in the text editor
  • Tools Menu — Actions now under Tools → LogParser Pro (not main menu)
  • Rich Settings — 10 configurable options
  • Enhanced Editor — 6-column table with level toggle buttons
  • Export — Export filtered entries to CSV, JSON, or plain text
  • Tool Window Tabs — Log Viewer, Search, Correlation, and Statistics tabs
  • Package Consolidation — All code under com.jakubjirak.logparser.pro
